Subject: Q2 ops snapshot & QBR prep — impact ladders and targeted asks

Team — sending a concise ops snapshot ahead of tomorrow's exec QBR run-through. I captured the high-level wins, near-term risks that will affect Q2 ARR/latency targets, and 3 targeted asks where I need leadership decisions or resource commits. Attachment: QBR_Impact_Tracker_v3.xlsx

Wins:
- Inference engine v1.8 rollout completed (region-us-west) — median p95 latency down 12% on gen-2 models.
- New batching heuristics shipped to production; expected token-cost savings ~9% for low-variance workloads.
- Two pilot customers (ACME + BrightFlow) on Dedicated beta, early feedback positive.

Risks (prioritized by impact):
1) Dedicated GPU capacity risk: demand spike forecast for May due to Partner X pilot; current pool lacks margin for 2-week sustained load (affects revenue throughput and SLA).
2) On-prem private deployment regressions: recent KB change caused slower KV-cache warmups in some legacy cases (observed with 3 customers).
3) Q2 evaluation regressions: model delta in reranking tests shows subtle recall drop vs baseline for internal testset (investigating).

Targeted Asks (decision / owner / date):
- Approve temporary reserved burst pool (4 A100 equiv) for May pilot — owner: laura_bennett — decision by 2027-04-06 EOD.
- Greenlight a fast-track patch for KV warmup (engineering time + canary) — owner: jonas_weber — decision by 2027-04-07 noon.
- Approve creating a small on-call task force for evaluation regressions (2 engineers x 2 weeks) — owner: vanessa_ortiz — feedback by 2027-04-05.

Notes: I've put a one-page impact ladder in the attached tracker that maps each risk to potential ARR/latency outcomes and suggested mitigations. Please review before tomorrow's 9am QBR dry-run.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Adding detail on the Dedicated GPU capacity risk (INFRA-6720):
- Current capacity utilization baseline for us-west pool is ~84% during peak; projected pilot load adds +18% at pilot start -> exceeds planned headroom.
- Options: (A) Spin up 4 x A100-equivalents temporarily (fast, higher cost), (B) Re-route lower-priority background jobs to secondary region (slower, operational lift), (C) Use quantized model variant for pilot (reduces accuracy budget).

Cost estimate (rough): 4 x A100-equiv burst for 2 weeks ≈ $38k. I pushed the cost breakdown to the tracker tab (see link). If Laura wants me to proceed I can create an infra change ticket with ETA = 48 hrs for pool provisioning.

Also flags on KV warmup: root cause looks like a timing regression in the cache priming logic introduced during last release (v1.8) — I have a patch ready; needs 1 full day of tests and a canary window.

Jonas

Head of Platform Engineering
